name: Circuit
_about: Circuit, generated by tools/gen_circuit.py (edit that and regenerate): after the owner's photo of a race car's round dial (26 Nov 2026). The rev dial in the middle with the gear in its hub, the speed on the left over the gearbox's box, the fuel and the battery as stacks of bars at the ends with their ranges, on the right a panel framed by two white lines with the BC views. With the map: the map in the middle, the dial smaller on the left. Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
